title: archangelica officinalis
intro: Archangelica officinalis, commonly known as Wild Angelica or Garden Angelica, is a perennial plant in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It has been used in traditional herbal medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and acting as an expectorant to help clear congestion. The therapeutic actions of Archangelica officinalis include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antimicrobial effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Archangelica officinalis contribute to its antioxidant, antiviral, and anti-cancer properties, making it a valuable herb in traditional medicine.
